_readme: Medical reviewers credited on health pages (content/README.md section 9). A page names its reviewer with the front matter key reviewedBy (the id below) plus reviewedAt (YYYY-MM-DD). Entries with "placeholder": true, or without name, credentials, registration number and council, are never shown publicly. Only add a real person with their written consent and a verifiable medical registration.

reviewers.name: PLACEHOLDER - replace with the medical reviewer's full name

registration.council: PLACEHOLDER - e.g. the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission

reviewers.bio: PLACEHOLDER - one or two sentences on clinical experience relevant to the pages reviewed.
